Grace Owusu
grace.owusu@example.com | Philadelphia, PA
Grace Owusu has 7 years of experience in frontend. Most recently, Senior
Frontend Developer at Crestline Technologies (2025-2026), where they
implemented Next.js component libraries shared across product teams. Before
that, Frontend Developer at Meridian Data (2022-2025). Before that, Junior
Frontend Developer at Vertex Labs (2019-2022). Education: B.S. Computer
Science, University of Florida, 2018. Core skills: Distributed systems, REST
API design, REST API design, Node.js, MongoDB, Node.js, Next.js, CSS3.
